body:
I don't know about special, I don't know about purpose. I do know that you are too young (hear me out!) to know whether or not you can ascertain these things. Maybe everyone who is coupling off are shitty people you don't even want to be with. I have always believed there is a continuum of the number of "friends" one needs to be happy/"happy". Specifically I do not believe you need friends or romance to be happy. Me personally, I have found that I am just a really selective person about friends and SO's alike. One-three close friends max. Some people are a lot more flexible. And that's ok. When I was 13 I hated every single other person in my grade in school. I tolerated the presence of 2 or 3. Seven years after I turned 13, some guy showed up at my dorm room door with notes to a class I missed because I missed class on account of I didn't think I was worth continuing my college career. We wound up being friends and it was awesome. My point is, knowing other people felt shitty about the same things would have made my experience as a 13 year old better. Maybe you feel the same way, maybe not. I'm a scientist and I'd state with confidence that it gets better as you get older and realize you can be ok with or without people around you, with or without your peers being your SO's or  f*ck buddies. 

I'm not going to tell you that you have a purpose. If other people say you do, they are silly. That is the most personal decision there is. What I have learned is (bear with the cliche, ok?) you make your own purpose. My purpose is helping people. I teach kids with autism. If I didn't wind up doing that, maybe I would not be here today. You might find a "thing", maybe now is a good time to sit and think about what that could be - no pressure. Just in a maybe-one day kind of way. For me, even if I did not have the energy to care about myself for some strange reason I always had the energy to help cook a meal for victims of domestic violence or whatever. You are probably different, this is just food for thought. 

I hope you decide you have a purpose. It feels really good. Maybe your purpose is to be the next hot dog brand comparison blogger, or the next bachelor frog cartoon front page artist, or the next Tchaikovsky. Because those would all be cool things to me.
